result.title: P-ContextBench: From Personal Fact Recall to Personalized Agent Behavior
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for personal tasks, yet evaluating their safe use of personal context remains difficult because such contexts are private, fragmented, dynamic, and socially situated. We introduce P-ContextBench, a realistic, verifiable, and scalable benchmark for evaluating personal-context understanding. P-ContextBench constructs population-structured, life-story-grounded digital humans from demographic seeds reflecting the U.S. population. Rather than using explicit, static profiles, P-ContextBench embeds traits, routines, goals, and constraints as implicit evidence across fragmented, evolving synthetic mobile-app records. It evaluates five capabilities: single-source fact recovery, multi-source fact recovery, temporal state tracking, inference of higher-level personal patterns from routine behavior, and safe handling of requests conflicting with persona-specific constraints through compliance, warning, clarification, or refusal. A multi-stage validation pipeline checks persona plausibility, context recoverability, information leakage, evidence preservation, test-case grounding, and human-judge agreement. We instantiate P-ContextBench with 100 personas, 10,088 hidden facts, 18,261 app-trace fragments, and 4,810 verified test cases. The pipeline supports configurable generation across scales and demographic groups. Cost-effective state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs relevant to personal agents achieve below 60% accuracy on temporal tracking, higher-level pattern inference, and constraint-aware action-boundary decisions, with fewer than 10% of test cases answered correctly across all three repeated runs. Even a high-performing SOTA model remains inconsistent on these capabilities. P-ContextBench provides measurable targets for improving the accuracy, reliability, and safety of LLM-based personal agents.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 P-ContextBench：以人口统计种子构造生活史接地的合成数字人，把特征、目标与约束隐含在碎片化、动态变化的手机应用记录中，评测单源/多源事实恢复、时序状态跟踪、高层行为模式推断以及约束冲突下的安全响应，并配套多阶段验证流程。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「碎片化多源证据恢复＋时序状态跟踪＋证据保留与泄漏校验」的基准设计，可能为 LVR 中检验 latent 状态是否保留并正确使用视觉证据、如何随推理更新提供评测参照，但论文本身不涉及视觉输入或 latent 推理机制。
